method: Sequential public-query snapshots with five-second spacing, not a statistical benchmark. Counts summed per query, not globally unique. Each query records its parameters: filtered and unfiltered phases are different workloads. Seven calls of the four-engine unfiltered phase completed before it was stopped following Mojeek HTTP 403. Tracking normalization removes common tracking keys and fragments, normalizes hosts and trailing slashes. Keyword matches are a heuristic, not judged accuracy.
